caption: The drawing features a single, pointed-toe flat shoe rendered in shades of light olive green and beige. The shoe has a ruffle trim around the top opening, which is a yellowish color. The upper surface of the shoe, near the pointed toe, has an embroidered floral or botanical motif in dark green and gold tones. The sole and interior lining of the shoe are depicted in beige and gray shades, providing contrast against the light green exterior. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and there is a signature reading "Jean Pagel" to the right of the shoe. There are no other objects or elements in the composition.
title: Woman's Slipper
